claim: Three control prototypes exist, but the displayed trials do not support a unified ranking.

panels.left: Fixed and periodic frequency/power from the same historical run, retain every intersecting record including scan and protection.
panels.right: Independent historical Kphi=5 trial, model input-phase error and power. Frequency is frozen throughout the displayed fs-5% segment.

archetype: quantitative grid with separate provenance frames
statistics: Deterministic historical model records, no biological or hardware replicates, no uncertainty or significance claims.
processing: Window 2.2 <= t < 3.2 s. Display zero-order holds with original durations for main timeline and 20 ms for historical phase samples. No smoothing, rescaling, offset, or removal of scan/protection records.
risks: Different runs and schedules of protection/probes cannot be ranked together.
Phase is model arg(Zin), including during zero amplitude; it is not a measured phase during shutdown.
Gain 5 results alone do not prove small phase error and low power.
Power is electrical dissipation in Rm, not acoustic power.
At 2.2 s the prior segment is Rm+50%, not baseline.
